v26
• Home screen now shows Spent this month and Fixed & EMIs due, and the two together. Tap either to open it
• Fixed: totals were sometimes read from the date (for example 30.09 instead of 2.59) or from a time stamp. Dates, times and weights are no longer mistaken for amounts
• Dates are found far more often: OCR slips (3O.O9.2O26), dates split over two lines and written months (7. Oktober 2026) are understood. Impossible dates (year 2028 or 2010) are rejected
• Store names: labels such as Total, Quantity, Receipt or Farbe 1 are no longer picked as the shop. More shops are recognised (KFC, Lieferando, New Yorker and others)
• Store learning rewritten: it now keeps only lines that identify the shop (VAT number, phone, address), merges repeats into one entry and no longer mixes shops up. Existing entries are tidied automatically
• Templates: Müller and dm are recognised reliably. REWE, Müller, dm and C&A fall back to the general reader for anything they miss, and a missing total is taken from the items
• Export All Data now includes the OCR text of every bill

v25
• Bills can now be imported from a PDF (for example an Amazon invoice): choose Choose PDF when adding a bill, or share the PDF to Bill Scanner from Gmail, your browser or the Files app
• PDF bills are stored as the original PDF, shown with a page viewer, and included in Export All Data

v24
• New tile: Fixed & EMIs. Track fixed monthly expenses and EMIs that run for a set number of months, with installments paid, end month and balance still to pay
• Home screen tiles re-arranged into groups

v23
• Fixed an app-build error caused by incorrectly written text resources

v22
• Fixed the GitHub build failure ("plugin com.android.application not found") by declaring plugin versions in settings.gradle.kts
• Card photo picker now says "Add a card photo" instead of "Add a bill"

v21
• Customer Cards: store loyalty/discount card photos in the app (new home-screen tile), with support for multiple photos per card
• Fixed: rotating a photo now updates on screen immediately, not just after leaving and returning
• Added this Version History screen

v20
• Added recognition templates for Müller, dm, and C&A, alongside REWE
• Receipt template engine now supports different item layouts per store

v19
• Added "Export All Data" - saves the photo of every bill (renamed) and all details as JSON to your phone, and offers to share a zip

v18
• Added the first receipt-template recognition system, starting with REWE, shown alongside the generic parser for comparison

v17
• Added photo rotation from the scan confirm screen and the full photo viewer
• Added pinch-to-zoom and double-tap-to-zoom on bill photos
• Store name field is now an autocomplete dropdown of previously-used stores

v16
• Added a Notes field on bills
• Added manual bill entry without a photo
